items.text: Giants GM Schoen: RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. placed on IR with hamstring; ETR had watched both Tracy/Skattebo hams Sunday.
items.implication: Giants RB depth thinned (bye helps Skattebo recover); Skattebo role secure if healthy.
items.opportunity: Skattebo snap/carry increase if cleared; other backups.

items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pregame; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf improvement Saturday with no setbacks expected.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday; optimistic path confirmed official active.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; no reverse of prior stashes.

items.text: ETR flagged Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM; Rapoport sources said unlikely to play (not full participant yet after quad); inactive path confirmed, Allen handled work.
items.why: Early in return from quad; not full practice participant.
items.implication: Monitor Week 8 practice; handcuff elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snap/carry share expansion while out.

items.text: ETR EXPECTED TO PLAY Saquon Barkley; Schefter confirmed ACTIVE for MNF and post-game Saquon said hamstring 'came out great', back not expected to sideline him.
items.why: Gutsy efficient effort; self-report positive on hamstring/back.

items.text: Berry: Put respect on Tee Higgins name. Also Coleman (Jonah) first game back led DEN snaps 50%/rush 41%/routes 34% (Dobbins 21%, Harvey fluky TD) — LOVE/upgrade. Pollard exploded — sell-high if possible. Jacobs ROS value positive.
items.why: Higgins production respect; Coleman usage lead post-return; Pollard spike sell; Jacobs return value.
items.implication: Higgins WR2 start; Coleman waiver priority/upgrade over committee; Pollard trade bait; Jacobs hold/start.
items.opportunity: Coleman 50/41/34 shares = clear lead; Higgins targets; Jacobs volume.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: arguably worst NFL runner (last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 full-PPR PPG via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy RB2 despite tape; hold/start confidently.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 carries + RB-leading targets = TD/rec upside.

items.text: ETR watching Jahmyr Gibbs ankle (turned on purposeful slide); Campbell/Gibbs postgame: checked, should be good, pain went away quickly. Levitan notes Lions PPG elite with Gibbs RB1.
items.why: Purposeful slide; quick resolution per coach/player.
items.implication: No missed time expected; maintain elite RB1.

items.text: ETR listed Lamar Jackson OUT (ankle); continues multi-week absence, Huntley handling snaps.
items.why: High-ankle sprain lingering; practice will decide Week 8.
items.implication: Ravens pass game muted until return; Flowers still elite YPRR.
items.opportunity: Huntley/backup QB streaming; Flowers volume stable.

items.text: ETR OUT: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks; opened slot/usage for others in PHI pass game vs DAL.
items.implication: Elevated targets to remaining WRs/TEs; Berry bet Lemon o40.5.
items.opportunity: Slot/route share expansion for available PHI pass-catchers.

items.text: ETR IN: Josh Jacobs active/returned; Berry discusses ROS fantasy value as Packers RB workhorse post-layoff.
items.implication: RB2/flex ROS with volume; monitor committee.

items.text: Berry: When talking workhorse RBs we are NOT talking Bucky Irving enough; emphasizes heavy usage role.
items.opportunity: High snap/rush share as clear lead back.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Doyle/Lamar healthy return impact.
items.why: Elite efficiency persists without Lamar; full offense unlock pending.
items.implication: WR1 upside spikes on Lamar return; hold through absence.
items.opportunity: YPRR + target share with better QB = ceiling raise.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Tank Dell only 6 in first game since 2024 (limited), Noel 15 (turf toe exit).
items.why: Route lead confirms alpha role post-Dell return limited.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell slow ramp.

items.text: Chiefs WR routes (no Rice): Xavier Worthy 33 on 36 Mahomes dropbacks; but in 37 career games never topped 83 receiving yards (ceiling concern).
items.why: Route monster without Rice but historical yardage ceiling low.
items.implication: Volatile WR3/flex; volume without efficiency/TD spike risk.
items.opportunity: 33 routes = high target opportunity while Rice out.
